details: Batch for Nov 26 sent, waiting for approval
summary: Of the 35 reels posted in the last 7 days (Nov 19 to 25), only 14 can be counted; the other 21 show 0 to 3 views, and every one of those is a book that had already run on an earlier day. The 14 counted reels drew 4,419 views in total, typically about 137 each. The typical 3-second hold is 17.5%, down from 18.5% the week before (on 9,506 views). In the current block, O6 (the book shown spine first, then turning to the cover) held 16.8% on 128 views from one reel. O1 (a count from the book as the first line) has no reel with views yet, so there is no gap to report and the sample is too small to mean anything. Best recent reel by 3-second hold: The Sealed Nectar, 24.6% on 144 views. Worst: Al-Mutoon al-Jami'ah, 11.0% on 124 views. Today's batch is day 2 of the same test, O6 spine first against O1 number fact, on five different books from yesterday.
